tools.name: attribute_cp_receipt
tools.description: Credit a pending silver receipt after sender review. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: dismiss_cp_report
tools.description: Dismiss an unhandled report with an audit reason. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Find bounded player candidates in one clan. Similar names remain separate candidates. Required scopes: insights:read

tools.name: get_chest_reward_insights
tools.description: Read aggregate observed chest rewards with denominators and coverage. This is not official game probability. Required scopes: rewards:read

tools.name: get_clan_content
tools.description: Read visible rules, announcements, events and the caller's outstanding tasks. Required scopes: content:read

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: List authorized clans, roles, locale, presentation timezone, and the Total Battle game-day boundary. `game_day.timezone` is UTC; `starts_at` is when a new game day begins, `reset_at` is the matching daily boundary, and `duration_hours` is its length. Use this boundary instead of calendar midnight fo

tools.name: get_cp_balance
tools.description: Read period-independent personal silver balances, or all clan balances for a superior. Required scopes: cp:read

tools.name: get_cp_history
tools.description: Read a bounded page of silver entries for one game progress ID. Required scopes: cp:read

tools.name: get_game_calendar
tools.description: Read bounded occurrences of the configured global game schedule, including historical UTC start/end bounds. This is not observed game evidence or clan-authored content. Officer access required. Discover cycle filters in cycle_options; windows are at most 90 days. Required scopes: context:read

tools.name: get_insight
tools.description: Read officer-authorized Insights. Requirements: legacy period_id returns full detail; detail=summary enables bounded score pages. Example: family=requirements, detail=summary, period_selector=last_completed, period_count=4, aggregate=player, sort=total_points, page_size=10. Or use period_id / period

tools.name: get_insight_options
tools.description: List authorized periods, report families, resources and player filter candidates. Required scopes: insights:read

tools.name: get_my_progress
tools.description: Read the caller's personal progress, requirements and collection freshness. Required scopes: personal:read

tools.name: legacy_stacking
tools.description: List, load or calculate legacy stacking. Beta layouts and writes are rejected. Required scopes: stacking:calculate

tools.name: list_cp_collector_costs
tools.description: Read recent collector runs with itemized base, caravan, and report credit reservations and settlements. Required scopes: cp:read

tools.name: list_cp_reports
tools.description: Read a bounded page of unhandled CP reports for clan leadership. Required scopes: cp:read

tools.name: list_periods
tools.description: List bounded stored Runekist reporting periods, which are not automatically game days, without creating period rows. Required scopes: context:read

tools.name: post_cp_run
tools.description: Post a named selection of CP reports after reviewing its exact preview. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: post_manual_cp_run
tools.description: Post a historical manual CP run with explicit progress IDs and a UTC date. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: preview_cp_run
tools.description: Preview exact member charges for selected ready report sources without posting. Required scopes: cp:read

tools.name: reconcile_manual_cp_run
tools.description: Link a historical manual CP charge to a subsequently observed Journal UUID without charging again. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: record_cp_payment
tools.description: Record exact received silver for a game progress ID. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: reverse_cp_run
tools.description: Reverse a posted CP run with an audit reason. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: set_cp_options
tools.description: Set default-off CP ledger and independent collector addons where permitted. Required scopes: cp:write

tools.name: transfer_cp_silver
tools.description: Transfer exact silver between two game progress IDs. Required scopes: cp:write
